from t_int_session s left join t_sch_appointment a on a.apt_id = s.ses_appointment_id left join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id left join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = p.pos_company_id left join t_tal t on t.tal_id = s.ses_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join sys_user iu on iu.user_id = s.ses_interviewer_id left join t_int_template tpl on tpl.itl_id = s.ses_template_id left join t_int_meeting_state m on m.mst_session_id = s.ses_id
mapper.select: select bnd_company_id from t_cmp_binding where bnd_user_id = #{userId} and bnd_status = 1 limit 1

where s.ses_status in (0, 1) and (t.tal_user_id = #{userId} or s.ses_interviewer_id = #{userId} or exists (select 1 from t_int_session_interviewer si where si.isi_session_id = s.ses_id and si.isi_user_id = #{userId})) order by (s.ses_status = 1) desc, a.apt_start_time asc limit 1

select a.apt_id as appointmentId, s.ses_id as sessionId, p.pos_id as positionId, p.pos_title as positionTitle, c.cmp_name as companyName, date_format(a.apt_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as startAt, date_format(a.apt_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as endAt, a.apt_status as appointmentStatus, s.ses_status as sessionStatus, s.ses_mode as mode, s.ses_room_token as roomToken, case when s.ses_status = 1 then '进行中' when s.ses_status = 2 then '已结束' when a.apt_start_time >= now() then '待面试' else '待确认' end as statusText from t_sch_appointment a join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.apt_candidate_id join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.apt_position_id left join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = p.pos_company_id left join t_int_session s on s.ses_appointment_id = a.apt_id where t.tal_user_id = #{userId} and a.apt_start_time >= #{from} and a.apt_start_time < #{to} and a.apt_status in (0, 1) order by a.apt_start_time asc, a.apt_id asc

select
where s.ses_id = #{sessionId}

select t.tal_id as candidateId, t.tal_user_id as userId, t.tal_company_id as companyId, ifnull(u.nick_name, u.user_name) as candidateName from t_tal t left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where t.tal_user_id = #{userId} and t.tal_company_id = #{companyId} limit 1

mapper.update: update t_int_session set ses_room_id = #{roomId}, ses_room_token = #{roomToken}, ses_updated_at = sysdate() where ses_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: select a.app_id as applicationId, p.pos_id as positionId, p.pos_title as positionTitle, a.app_status as appStatus, t.tal_id as candidateId, cur.psg_id as currentStageId, cur.psg_name as currentStageName, cur.psg_type as currentStageType, cur.psg_sort_order as currentStageSort, (select count(*) from t_process_stage s2 where s2.psg_template_id = p.pos_process_template_id) as totalStages from t_app_record a join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.app_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.app_candidate_id left join t_process_instance pi on pi.pin_id = ( select pi2.pin_id from t_process_instance pi2 where pi2.pin_candidate_id = t.tal_id and pi2.pin_position_id = p.pos_id order by pi2.pin_id desc limit 1) left join t_process_stage cur on cur.psg_id = pi.pin_current_stage_id where t.tal_user_id = #{peerUserId} and p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} order by a.app_updated_at desc

select psg.psg_id as stageId, psg.psg_name as name, psg.psg_type as type, psg.psg_sort_order as sortOrder, cast(json_unquote(json_extract(psg.psg_interviewer_config_json, '$.duration')) as signed) as duration from t_pos p join t_process_stage psg on psg.psg_template_id = p.pos_process_template_id where p.pos_id = #{positionId} and p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} order by psg.psg_sort_order

sysdate() null , sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update pst_role = #{role}, pst_cam_status = #{camStatus}, pst_mic_status = #{micStatus}, pst_speaker_status = #{speakerStatus}, pst_net_status = #{netStatus}, pst_net_rtt_ms = #{rttMs,jdbcType=INTEGER}, pst_net_bandwidth_kbps = #{bandwidthKbps,jdbcType=INTEGER}, pst_risk_flag = #{riskFlag}, pst_device_json = #{deviceJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR},

mapper.select: select p.pst_user_id as userId, p.pst_role as role, p.pst_cam_status as camStatus, p.pst_mic_status as micStatus, p.pst_speaker_status as speakerStatus, p.pst_net_status as netStatus, p.pst_net_rtt_ms as rttMs, p.pst_net_bandwidth_kbps as bandwidthKbps, p.pst_risk_flag as riskFlag, p.pst_ready as ready, p.pst_in_meeting as inMeeting, date_format(p.pst_waiting_at, '%H:%i:%s') as waitingAt, ifnull(u.nick_name, u.user_name) as userName from t_int_participant_state p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.pst_user_id where p.pst_session_id = #{sessionId} order by p.pst_role asc
mapper.insert: insert into t_int_meeting_state (mst_session_id, mst_total_question, mst_current_question, mst_duration_seconds, mst_remaining_seconds, mst_created_at, mst_updated_at) select s.ses_id, (select count(*) from t_int_outline o where o.oln_session_id = s.ses_id), 0, timestampdiff(second, a.apt_start_time, a.apt_end_time), timestampdiff(second, a.apt_start_time, a.apt_end_time), sysdate(), sysdate() from t_int_session s left join t_sch_appointment a on a.apt_id = s.ses_appointment_id where s.ses_id = #{sessionId} on duplicate key update mst_session_id = mst_session_id
mapper.select: select m.mst_total_question as totalQuestionNo, m.mst_current_question as answeredCount, m.mst_duration_seconds as durationSeconds, m.mst_remaining_seconds as remainingSeconds, m.mst_mic_enabled as micEnabled, m.mst_cam_enabled as camEnabled, m.mst_speaker_volume as speakerVolume, m.mst_cam_status as camStatus, m.mst_mic_status as micStatus, m.mst_speaker_status as speakerStatus, m.mst_net_status as netStatus, m.mst_net_rtt_ms as rttMs, m.mst_net_bandwidth_kbps as bandwidthKbps, m.mst_risk_flag as riskFlag, m.mst_takeover as takeover, m.mst_takeover_reason as takeoverReason, date_format(m.mst_heartbeat_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as heartbeatAt, if(s.ses_status = 1 and s.ses_start_at is not null, timestampdiff(second, s.ses_start_at, sysdate()), 0) as elapsedSeconds, s.ses_status as sessionStatus from t_int_meeting_state m join t_int_session s on s.ses_id = m.mst_session_id where m.mst_session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.update: update t_int_meeting_state set mst_cam_status = #{camStatus}, mst_mic_status = #{micStatus}, mst_speaker_status = #{speakerStatus}, mst_net_status = #{netStatus}, mst_net_rtt_ms = #{rttMs,jdbcType=INTEGER}, mst_net_bandwidth_kbps = #{bandwidthKbps,jdbcType=INTEGER}, mst_risk_flag = #{riskFlag}, mst_device_json = #{deviceJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, mst_updated_at = sysdate() where mst_session_id = #{sessionId}
update t_int_meeting_state set mst_takeover = #{takeover}, mst_takeover_reason = #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, mst_updated_at = sysdate() where mst_session_id = #{sessionId}

select oln_id as questionId, oln_topic as topic, oln_description as description, oln_dimension as dimension from t_int_outline where oln_session_id = #{sessionId} order by oln_order asc, oln_id asc limit #{offset}, 1
select oln_id as questionId, oln_topic as topic, oln_description as hint, oln_dimension as dimension from t_int_outline where oln_session_id = #{sessionId} order by oln_order asc, oln_id asc

mapper.select: select cpt_id as id, cpt_seq as seq, cpt_mode as mode, cpt_content as content, cpt_reference as reference, cpt_points as points, cpt_status as status, cpt_adopted_content as adoptedContent, date_format(cpt_created_at, '%H:%i:%s') as at from t_int_copilot where cpt_session_id = #{sessionId} and cpt_seq > #{afterSequence} order by cpt_seq asc limit #{limit}

update t_int_session set ses_status = #{status}, ses_end_at = sysdate(), ses_updated_at = sysdate() where ses_id = #{sessionId}

mapper.select: select s.ses_id as sessionId, s.ses_status as status, s.ses_mode as mode, date_format(s.ses_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startAt, date_format(s.ses_end_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as endAt, if(s.ses_start_at is null, 0, timestampdiff(second, s.ses_start_at, ifnull(s.ses_end_at, sysdate()))) as durationSeconds, ifnull(m.mst_current_question, 0) as answeredCount, ifnull(m.mst_total_question, 0) as totalQuestionNo, (select count(*) from t_int_evaluation e where e.evl_session_id = s.ses_id) as reportGenerated from t_int_session s left join t_int_meeting_state m on m.mst_session_id = s.ses_id where s.ses_id = #{sessionId}

select ifnull(sum(r.rcd_duration_sec), 0) as totalSeconds, ifnull(sum(r.rcd_size_bytes), 0) as totalBytes, ifnull(sum(case when ifnull(r.rcd_size_bytes, 0) = 0 then ifnull(r.rcd_duration_sec, 0) else 0 end), 0) as estSeconds from t_int_recording r join t_int_session s on s.ses_id = r.rcd_session_id join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId}

select r.rcd_id as recordingId, r.rcd_code as code, r.rcd_seq as seq, r.rcd_status as status, date_format(r.rcd_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startedAt from t_int_recording r where r.rcd_session_id = #{sessionId} and r.rcd_status = 0 order by r.rcd_id desc limit 1
select ifnull(max(rcd_seq), 0) + 1 from t_int_recording where rcd_session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_int_recording (rcd_session_id, rcd_code, rcd_seq, rcd_start_at, rcd_status, rcd_url, rcd_access_level) values (#{sessionId}, #{code}, #{seq}, sysdate(), 0, #{url}, #{accessLevel})
mapper.update: update t_int_recording set rcd_egress_id = #{egressId}, rcd_updated_at = sysdate() where rcd_id = #{recordingId}

update t_int_recording set rcd_status = 1, rcd_end_at = sysdate(), rcd_duration_sec = greatest(timestampdiff(second, rcd_start_at, sysdate()), 0), rcd_expires_at = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{keepDays} day), rcd_updated_at = sysdate() where rcd_id = #{recordingId} and rcd_status = 0

update t_int_recording set rcd_status = #{status}, rcd_end_at = ifnull(rcd_end_at, sysdate()), rcd_duration_sec = ifnull(#{durationSec,jdbcType=INTEGER}, rcd_duration_sec), rcd_size_bytes = ifnull(#{sizeBytes,jdbcType=BIGINT}, rcd_size_bytes), rcd_url = ifnull(#{recUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, rcd_url), rcd_expires_at = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{keepDays} day), rcd_updated_at = sysdate() where rcd_egress_id = #{egressId}

update t_int_recording set rcd_status = 2, rcd_end_at = ifnull(rcd_end_at, sysdate()), rcd_duration_sec = ifnull(rcd_duration_sec, greatest(timestampdiff(second, rcd_start_at, sysdate()), 0)), rcd_updated_at = sysdate() where rcd_session_id = #{sessionId} and rcd_status = 0
mapper.select: select r.rcd_id as recordingId, r.rcd_session_id as sessionId, r.rcd_url as recUrl, r.rcd_access_level as accessLevel, r.rcd_status as status, p.pos_company_id as companyId, t.tal_user_id as candidateUserId, s.ses_interviewer_id as interviewerId from t_int_recording r join t_int_session s on s.ses_id = r.rcd_session_id join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = s.ses_candidate_id where r.rcd_id = #{recordingId}

select r.rcd_id as recordingId, r.rcd_code as code, r.rcd_session_id as sessionId, r.rcd_url as recUrl, ifnull(r.rcd_duration_sec, 0) as durationSec, r.rcd_size_bytes as recSizeBytes, r.rcd_status as status, date_format(r.rcd_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as interviewDate, date_format(r.rcd_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startAt, ifnull(u.nick_name, u.user_name) as candidateName, p.pos_title as positionTitle, s.ses_mode as mode, r.rcd_access_level as recAccessLevel, date_format(r.rcd_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as recExpiresAt, case when s.ses_mode = 1 then null else ifnull(iu.nick_name, iu.user_name) end as primaryInterviewerName from t_int_recording r join t_int_session s on s.ses_id = r.rcd_session_id join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = s.ses_candidate_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join sys_user iu on iu.user_id = s.ses_interviewer_id where r.rcd_id = #{recordingId}
mapper.update: update t_int_recording set rcd_access_level = #{level}, rcd_expires_at = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{validDays} day), rcd_updated_at = sysdate() where rcd_id = #{recordingId}
mapper.select: select rcp_id as policyId, rcp_company_id as companyId, rcp_keep_days as keepDays, rcp_max_storage_gb as maxStorageGb, rcp_default_access_level as defaultAccessLevel from t_int_recording_policy where rcp_company_id = #{companyId} or rcp_company_id is null order by (rcp_company_id is null) asc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_int_recording_policy (rcp_company_id, rcp_keep_days, rcp_max_storage_gb, rcp_created_at, rcp_updated_at) values (#{companyId}, #{keepDays}, #{maxStorageGb}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update rcp_keep_days = #{keepDays}, rcp_max_storage_gb = #{maxStorageGb}, rcp_updated_at = sysdate()

insert into t_int_session_interviewer (isi_session_id, isi_user_id, isi_is_primary, isi_join_status, isi_created_at, isi_updated_at) values (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{isPrimary}, 0, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update isi_is_primary = #{isPrimary}, isi_updated_at = sysdate()
mapper.select: select si.isi_user_id as userId, si.isi_is_primary as isPrimary, si.isi_join_status as joinStatus, si.isi_muted_av as mutedAv, date_format(si.isi_joined_at, '%H:%i:%s') as joinedAt, ifnull(u.nick_name, u.user_name) as userName from t_int_session_interviewer si left join sys_user u on u.user_id = si.isi_user_id where si.isi_session_id = #{sessionId} order by si.isi_is_primary desc, si.isi_id asc

select si.isi_session_id as sessionId, si.isi_is_primary as isPrimary, si.isi_accept_status as acceptStatus, s.ses_status as status, s.ses_mode as mode, p.pos_title as positionTitle, ifnull(u.nick_name, u.user_name) as candidateName, date_format(a.apt_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as appointmentStartAt, date_format(a.apt_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as appointmentEndAt, date_format(si.isi_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as noticeAt from t_int_session_interviewer si join t_int_session s on s.ses_id = si.isi_session_id left join t_sch_appointment a on a.apt_id = s.ses_appointment_id left join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id left join t_tal t on t.tal_id = s.ses_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where si.isi_user_id = #{userId} and s.ses_status <= 1 order by s.ses_start_at desc, si.isi_id desc
select isi_user_id from t_int_session_interviewer where isi_session_id = #{sessionId} order by isi_is_primary desc, isi_id asc limit 1
mapper.update: update t_int_session_interviewer set isi_join_status = 1, isi_joined_at = ifnull(isi_joined_at, sysdate()), isi_muted_av = #{mutedAv}, isi_updated_at = sysdate() where isi_session_id = #{sessionId} and isi_user_id = #{userId}
